what_to_detect: A blocked attacker with both deathtouch and trample assigns only 1 damage to each blocker as lethal and the rest to the defending player, so the player takes more than the attacker's power minus its blockers' summed remaining toughness.
near_miss: A damage-step probe fork re-runs the same combat with deathtouch stripped from the trampling attacker, which must then assign each blocker damage equal to its remaining toughness before any reaches the player.
record_fields: state.entities keywords of the attacker (deathtouch, trample)
state.entities combat.blocked_by and blockers' remaining toughness
payload damage_dealt events to the blockers and to the defending player
payload probed_keyword, probed_entity on the probe fork

what_to_detect: A creature is dealt noncombat damage below its toughness by a source that has left the battlefield and whose last known information carries deathtouch, and it moves from the battlefield to its owner's graveyard in the state-based check after the resolution.
near_miss: A creature dealt damage below its toughness by a source whose last known information has no deathtouch stays on the battlefield.

proposed.note: the deathtouch_damage check resolves a damage source only in state.entities; a source that left the battlefield before the effect half (sacrificed as a cost, or dead in response) must be read from gen-3 cards.last_known, whose keywords are the ones it had as it last existed on the battlefield

record_fields: payload damage_dealt event (subjects, amount, and its source in the cause parameter)
gen-3 state cards.last_known entity of the damage source (its keywords)
state.entities toughness and damage of the damaged creature
